corrections.issue: Global Q_TL_Accumulate signed-32 range axioms contradict the unbounded mathematical recurrence.
corrections.resolution: Keep the recurrence and read laws; require signed-range bounds only through p_accumulatebounds.

corrections.issue: The recursive laws quantify over character memory while l_strspn and l_strpbrk omit that memory argument, forcing one result to satisfy incompatible memories.
corrections.resolution: Pass the same character memory explicitly to every logical string-operation call.

corrections.issue: suit_sorted asserts inequality even when j1 equals j2.
corrections.resolution: Require j1 <> j2 before comparing the two positions.
